title: Reading Drill — Choosing a Route for an Outdoor Lesson
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Choosing a Route for an Outdoor Lesson
passages.body:
**A** An outdoor class used a short circular route to study plants. The first trial showed that local species were easy to find but descriptions could not be heard over the nearby main road.

**B** The teacher chose a quieter path and moved several activities to stopping points where the group could stand in a semicircle. Pupils were still asked to identify plants on both sides of the path.

**C** Teachers gave later classes a route card with suggested timings. An optional stop by a stream could be skipped if time was short, enabling groups to return for lunch.
